title: SF dinner / meetup invite
description: A type-only invite in the house look for a Bay Area dinner or meetup hosted by Massive: the headline big, who's hosting, and when, where and how to RSVP. Date, neighborhood and RSVP link are placeholders until they're set.

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.hint: Two or three words: You're invited, Join us

fields.label: Headline
fields.hint: Up to three lines; about 25 characters reads best

fields.label: Date
fields.hint: Day, date and time, e.g. Thu, March 4 · 7 pm. Leave the brackets until it's known

fields.label: Neighborhood
fields.hint: Neighborhood or venue, about 30 characters. Leave the brackets until it's known

fields.label: RSVP link
fields.hint: A short link without https://, about 30 characters. Leave the brackets until it's known
